description: Get final-expense life insurance quotes, including small burial/funeral coverage. Supports the platform coverage range of $5,000 to $100,000,000, subject to carrier/product limits. No term duration. Uses monthly or annual payments and an explicit assumed health value. Each returned quote_id can be used with create_life_eapp after user selection.

gender.description: Carrier rating input, supplied by the user

guaranteed_issue.description: Optional guaranteed-issue-only filter; defaults to false

health.description: Explicit assumed final-expense health value. Use the health_classes in get_life_quote_requirements; never infer eligibility.

mode.description: Payments per year: 1 annually or 12 monthly

frequency.description: Uses per year: 2 less than monthly, 12 monthly, 52 weekly, 365 daily

name: quote_final_expense
